verdict.rationale: Bun is a local CLI package manager/runtime that operates on the user's own files (package.json, lockfile, node_modules) rather than storing user data in a vendor-controlled service; there is no 'your data' held by Bun to export and no lock-in to escape. This 'export and leave' story targets SaaS/data-hosting products, which is a different axis than a local dev tool.
